W01.prompt: When I am doing my best work, I feel most energised when I can…

options.label: Lead & Influence
options.description: Guide people, make decisions, influence direction and take responsibility for outcomes.

options.label: Create & Innovate
options.description: Develop ideas, design something new, experiment and turn imagination into something practical.

options.label: Analyse & Solve
options.description: Investigate information, understand difficult problems, identify patterns and find answers.

options.label: Organise & Deliver
options.description: Create structure, coordinate details, keep things on track and make sure work is completed properly.

options.label: Help & Develop
options.description: Support people, teach, guide, solve people-related problems and contribute to growth.

options.label: Build & Improve
options.description: Fix things, improve systems, make processes work better and see a measurable result.

options.label: Connect & Persuade
options.description: Build relationships, negotiate, sell ideas and win support.

options.label: Work Independently & Master
options.description: Develop deep expertise, concentrate independently and become exceptionally good at a specialised area.

W03.prompt: I generally do my best work in an environment that is…

options.label: Structured & Predictable
options.description: Clear processes, responsibilities and expectations.

options.label: Fast-Moving & Varied
options.description: Changing priorities, different challenges and lots happening.

options.label: Independent & Focused
options.description: Freedom to concentrate and manage your own work.

options.label: Collaborative & People-Centred

W04.prompt: What matters most to you in satisfying work?

options.label: Achievement
options.description: Accomplishing difficult or meaningful goals.

options.label: Autonomy
options.description: Freedom and control over how you work.

options.label: Security
options.description: Stability, predictability and dependable conditions.

options.label: Growth
options.description: Continually learning and progressing.

options.label: Impact
options.description: Knowing your work meaningfully affects people or outcomes.

options.label: Recognition
options.description: Having strong performance noticed and valued.

options.label: Belonging
options.description: Being part of a strong team or community.

options.label: Variety
options.description: Change, stimulation and different challenges.
